cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have experience with capital equipment automation, project management, and strong critical thinking skills.

Lead the implementation of capital and non-capital projects by monitoring progress at vendors, support installation, validation, conducting trials and Go Live production efforts ensure equipment performance to specifications.
Apply statistical methods and data driven problem solving while continuously monitoring, analyzing and resolving process problems including the documentation of all proposals and validation results.
Source vendors, define SOW's and manage contract deliverables.
Provide technical support and guidance for plant operations through identifying and proactively developing solutions for issues impacting production operations.
Support our Lean culture through improving production processes and Kaizen Event participation.
Identify causes and develop strategies for eliminating re-occurring downtime.
Work with plant quality control and manufacturing personnel to ensure process and equipment is capable of producing product that meets quality and engineering standards.

Bachelor's degree
5+ Years of engineering experience
Experience with automation of capital equipment
Excellent critical thinking and project management skills

The ideal candidate will have experience with automation of capital equipment, project management, and strong critical thinking skills.

Provide technical support and guidance for plant operations by working alongside colleagues to identify issues and develop solutions that impact production.
Support our Lean culture by collaborating on production process improvements and participating in Kaizen Events.
Work with the team to identify causes of recurring downtime and develop shared strategies to eliminate it.
Coordinate with plant quality control and manufacturing personnel to help ensure processes and equipment can consistently produce product that meets quality and engineering standards.

Bachelor's degree
5+ Years of engineering experience
Experience with automation of capital equipment
Strong critical thinking and project management skills

Six Sigma knowledge
Experience with root cause analysis and process optimization
Knowledge of vision systems or industrial automation

Support our Lean culture through improving production processes and Kaizen Event participation.
